p: Bitcoin steht bei 76.013 Dollar, -5,0 Prozent in 24 Stunden und -1,8 Prozent in einer Woche.
Ethereum liegt bei 2.238 Dollar, -7,1 Prozent am Tag.
Der Gesamtmarkt ist 2,67 Billionen Dollar schwer, Bitcoin macht davon 57,1 Prozent aus.
Angst und Gier steht bei 28 von 100.
8 Prozent der 302 größten Coins liegen über ihrer 50-Tage-Linie, 15 Prozent über der 200-Tage-Linie.
Die Mehrheit liegt unter ihrem Durchschnitt. In solchen Phasen sind Erholungen meist kurzlebig.
Der durchschnittliche RSI liegt bei 34, also überverkauft.
Im Stablecoin-Markt liegen 294,6 Milliarden Dollar. In den letzten sieben Tagen sind 4,8 Milliarden Dollar abgeflossen.
In DeFi-Protokollen stecken 80,2 Milliarden Dollar. Vorn liegen Ethereum (43,4 Milliarden Dollar), Base (5,9 Milliarden Dollar), Solana (5,3 Milliarden Dollar).
Vorn liegt Gaming mit +2,2 Prozent in sieben Tagen über 46 Coins.
Am schwächsten ist L1 mit -5,5 Prozent.
Die Spanne zwischen stärkstem und schwächstem Sektor beträgt 8 Prozentpunkte. Es ist also kein Markt, in dem alles gleich läuft.
Die höchsten Gesamt-Scores haben KAVA (78), JST (73), WIN (70).
Größte Tagesgewinner über 100 Millionen Marktkapitalisierung: SYS +1303,9 Prozent, AKE +94,7 Prozent, TEL +18,8 Prozent.
Auffällige Divergenz bei JST: Über beiden Durchschnitten, RSI 54 im gesunden Bereich. Trend ohne Übertreibung.
Beim Social Buzz führen INJ (95), LIT (94), CORE (94).
Bei den Hidden Gems stehen oben: USUAL (74), GROVE (73), SYRUP (72), ETHFI (70).
Eine Bitcoin-Überweisung kostet gerade 1 Satoshi pro Byte für die schnelle Bestätigung.
Die Rechenleistung im Netzwerk hat sich in 30 Tagen um -7 Prozent verändert.
Bis zur nächsten Halbierung der Blockbelohnung sind es noch 75.230 Blöcke. also rund 522 Tage.

btc.zyklus: Das letzte Bitcoin-Halving war am 20.04.2024, das ist 31 Monate her. Bitcoin steht 40 % unter dem Allzeithoch. In den bisherigen Zyklen kam das Hoch rund 12 bis 18 Monate nach dem Halving, danach folgte ein längerer Rücksetzer. Es sind nur 3 bis 4 Zyklen, die Aussage ist eine Hypothese und kein Naturgesetz.

stimmung.herde_text: Die Herde ist unentschlossen. Kein Kontra-Signal, hier zählen Chart und Fundament mehr als die Stimmung.
lage: Angst und Gier steht bei 28 (Fear): keine Extremlage.
Stablecoin-Umlauf −12,94 Mrd $ in 30 Tagen. Kapital verlässt das System.
Makro: Leitzins 3,88 %, Rendite 10 Jahre 4,90 %. Hohe Realzinsen belasten Risikoanlagen (Hypothese, die in vielen Phasen galt).

news.t: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.z: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.t: Crypto exchanges tout cold storage ratios after Binance attack
news.z: Coinbase says it keeps more than 99% of customer assets offline, while Gate reports 88.26% of its total assets are kept in cold storage.

news.t: IREN’s bitcoin mining revenue drops 58% as firm plans full exit by year-end
news.z: IREN has been shifting its focus to the AI infrastructure business, and its AI cloud revenue rose 182% in the past quarter to $200 million.

news.t: Ark Invest buys more Coinbase as shares plunge 10% in wider market rout
news.z: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest bought $2.44 million worth of Coinbase on Thursday as the stock plunged 9.69% amid a broader sell-off.

news.t: Core Scientific to quit Bitcoin mining by year-end as AI business surges
news.z: The former Bitcoin mining heavyweight plans to become a pure-play data center provider in 2027, with mining now accounting for just 7.5% of quarterly revenue.

news.t: Claude Gets Personal Finance—Anthony Pompliano Accuses Anthropic of Copying His Startup
news.z: Anthropic's Claude finance assistant analyzes spending from linked accounts in the U.S., and Anthony Pompliano has a big problem with it.

news.t: American Bitcoin’s $126M profit masks mining pressure as rivals turn to AI
news.z: The Eric Trump-backed miner reported $126 million in quarterly net income, largely driven by gains on its Bitcoin holdings, despite rising mining costs and shrinking margins.

news.t: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express
news.z: Asian crypto exchanges are scrambling to tighten security on fears of a wave of potentially AI-assisted hacks, even as regional governments embrace tokenization and stablecoins.

news.t: Bitcoin Fixes This? Paraguay President Resigns After Bank Lockout Hits 60% of Country
news.z: Ueno’s collapse trapped millions of Paraguayan depositors and triggered a president’s resignation, reviving Bitcoin’s argument for self-custody.

news.t: Hyperliquid Strategies files to become CFTC-registered FCM, posts $13.3 million in quaterly revenue
news.z: Hyperliquid Strategies posted $13.3M in revenue and $620.6M net income, and filed with the CFTC to become an FCM for U.S. HIP-3 perp markets.

news.t: Bitcoin Price Trades Near $76,000 as Nasdaq Tumbles into Correction

news.t: Crypto ally French Hill wins reelection but set to lose House chair
news.z: Republican French Hill secured another term in Congress but will lose his leadership of the House Financial Services Committee when Democrats take control in January.

news.t: OpenAI Promises to Foot AI’s Power Bill After Voter Revolt. Who Enforces It?
news.z: OpenAI wants to ease the backlash against AI campuses with promises on electricity, water and secrecy. Its new compact raises a tougher question: Who would make the company comply?

news.t: DOJ Creates 'Super Intelligence' Task Force to Guard Against AI Abuse

news.t: Mercado Bitcoin Said Its Hack Was Contained, But Blockchain Data Tells a Different Story
news.z: Fresh forensic analysis traces $48.6 million across 11 blockchains and finds thousands of customer deposit addresses drained hours after the Brazilian exchange said it had stopped the breach on Monday.

news.t: Bitcoin erases post-election gains as Wall Street selloff triggers over $1 billion in crypto liquidations
news.z: Bitcoin fell 6% to $75,700 and ether 7% as a Nasdaq selloff hit crypto, triggering $1.03 billion in liquidations.

news.t: Zcash Upgrade Could Lock $16 Million in Crypto Forever
news.z: Zcash's latest upgrade promises faster transactions, but thousands of coins remain in an aging privacy system that will soon stop accepting withdrawals, potentially leaving their owners empty-handed.

news.t: OpenAI Found 948 Linux Security Flaws—And Figured Out How to Exploit Them
news.z: An automated OpenAI system produced working exploits and draft fixes at roughly $1,279 per flaw, raising new questions about how cheaply AI can find holes in critical software at scale.

news.t: Binance, Deribit revoke SignalPlus API keys after fake Teams invite attack
news.z: SignalPlus said attackers compromised an engineer’s computer in a breach that resulted in losses of less than $82,000, which the crypto trading platform pledged to reimburse in full.

news.t: Base deploys Denim upgrade on mainnet, replacing Flashblocks with 200ms block times
news.z: Base activated its fourth network upgrade, Denim, introducing five canonical blocks per second at 200ms intervals.

news.t: Greece Approves 10% Crypto Capital Gains Tax as First Framework Lands Below Draft Rate

news.t: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks
news.z: US regulators reportedly contacted banks following last week’s $6.3 billion Binance security hack, while experts raised concerns about transaction security and crypto risks.

news.t: Trump-Backed American Bitcoin Turns a Profit as Bitcoin Rise Lifts Books
news.z: The Hut 8-backed miner reversed a second-quarter loss, driven largely by a $197 million gain on its Bitcoin holdings.
